Gonzaga University School Overview Location Spokane, Washington Type Private not-for-profit Setting City Students Total Students 8,756 Faculty Total Faculty 1,197 Student/Faculty Ratio 11 : 1 Tuition Estimated Cost $48,990 Admissions Total Applicants 6,851 Admitted 65% Enrolled 17% Test Scores SAT Math560-690SAT Reading550-700SAT WritingNot ReportedACT Composite24-28TOEFLRequiredIELTSRequired About Gonzaga University Ranked #79 for National Universities (U.S. News & World Report, 2022), Gonzaga offers outstanding academics, ongoing support services, and a welcoming environment for international students. Here, you won’t be a face in the crowd: Student-to-faculty ratio averages 11:1, and our instructors also get top marks, with U.S. News ranking Gonzaga #18 for undergraduate teaching, #26 for graduate accounting programs, and #46 for part-time MBA. Robust career services, including internships and on-site company networking events, create an experience that prepares students to succeed. International Student Services Gonzaga is committed to supporting international students like you. When you enroll at Gonzaga Global, you receive exclusive benefits as part of our Signature Service Experience — at no extra charge! Visa application and interview help Student and family orientation English-language tutoring and ESL classes Courses tailored to your academic level Internship opportunities Professional development workshops And more! Apply Here Live and Study in Spokane Situated in the heart of the Inland Northwest in Spokane, Washington, Gonzaga offers international students a beautiful home away from home. Explore more than 100 state parks, hiking and biking trails, and whitewater rafting. (And the tech hub of Seattle is just a four-hour drive away.) Tuition and Housing Ranked as #21 in a national list of best-valued private universities based on relative cost, graduation rates and resulting post-graduation income and employment, quality of education, and overall rewarding experience, Gonzaga University is widely considered to be a good investment in your own future. The typical housing fees for one year at Gonzaga are around $12,000, but this may vary based on your choice of amenities, location, room, and program track. Transfer Direct Gonzaga Global offers Transfer Direct services as a key element of their Signature Student Experience. Designed specifically for international transfer students, it is a comprehensive support service that comes at no additional cost, and is eligible to any applicants with less than 60 advanced/post-secondary credits. Experts help students determine which credits are eligible for transfer and give students tailored advice and customized course recommendations to find the best path to graduation. Colleges College of Arts & Sciences- this school offers bachelor’s degrees across the humanities, arts, and natural and social sciences. Gonzaga believes that a strong foundation in the liberal arts tradition fosters scholarly inquiry, creativity, and collaboration. School of Business Administration- this school is ranked in the Top 100 for undergraduate business programs by the US News & World Report in 2021, and works to create global leaders who can think critically, solve problems creatively, and lead boldly. School of Education- this school creates inspiring classroom leaders who teach with care, competence, and a commitment to educating people for good. School of Engineering and Applied Sciences- this school aims to create intellectual curiosity and analytic skills, and all with a humanitarian outlook. The undergraduate engineering program at Gonzaga is ranked #23, #15 for civil engineering, and #27 for mechanical engineering by the US News and World Report in 2021. School of Nursing and Human Physiology- this school provides students with opportunities to serve vulnerable populations, research with amazing faculty, and engage with local, national, and international health communities.
